name: CrackNet
selection_reason: Fixed fold 1; not selected using outer test performance

validation.protocol: 5-fold OOF; label2 positive, label1 negative, labels3/4 ignored; 042 excluded
validation.scope: Cross-validation experiment; not a score for this single deployment checkpoint

Candidate pixels only; no condition grade, depth, cause, or strength

external_evaluation.dataset: SDNET2018 bridge-deck crops, public mirror v1
external_evaluation.scope: Image-level ranking, not segmentation IoU or on-site validation
